title: Reserve rigor for what must last
principle: Mod’s Books in the Age of the iPad / publishing essays: disposable content can be light; durable artifacts deserve material rigor. In product UI, separate ephemeral experiment surfaces from canonical pages—and spend craft budget on what persists.
procedure: Apply full typographic/spacing rigor to durable paths (settings, core workflows, public docs).
Allow faster, cheaper treatments for experiments—with an expiry.
When promoting ephemeral→durable, re-run craft (not just ship the prototype look).
examplePrompts:
Classify each screen ephemeral vs durable (Craig Mod publishing rigor):
- Durable: full typography, spacing, a11y pass.
- Ephemeral: note expiry + lighter treatment.
- Promotion checklist when an experiment graduates.
Return the classification table.
This prototype look leaked into billing—promote with a rigor pass or demote.
promptWhy: Classification stops equal craft spend on junk paths.
Promotion checklist prevents prototype chrome in production.
